Similar plasma p-tau217 AUCs masked differences in assay handling

AUC alone did not distinguish the three p-tau217 workflows: precision and freeze-thaw resilience differed.

Implementation-relevant•Alzheimer’s & Dementia: Diagnosis, Assessment & Disease Monitoring•November 2, 2026

Similar plasma p-tau217 AUCs masked differences in assay handling

AUC alone did not distinguish the three p-tau217 workflows: precision and freeze-thaw resilience differed.

Key quantitative results: p-tau217 AUCs were 0.88–0.89 versus 0.85 for p-tau181.

BiomarkersBloodp-tau217p-tau181Assay comparison

Added November 23, 2026 · DOI:10.1002/dad2.70465

Evidence summaryDesign, results, and what changed

Thirty-second field brief

AUC alone did not distinguish the three p-tau217 workflows: precision and freeze-thaw resilience differed. Require precision, specimen-handling, turnaround and regulatory fit alongside diagnostic performance when choosing a platform.

Study design

Head-to-head comparison of three p-tau217 assays and one p-tau181 assay, incorporating CSF-defined amyloid pathology and analytical handling tests.

Key quantitative results

  • p-tau217 AUCs were 0.88–0.89 versus 0.85 for p-tau181.
  • Automated platforms had better precision and tolerated at least six freeze-thaw cycles in the reported testing versus two for the MSD platform.

What changed

p-tau217 AUCs were 0.88–0.89 versus 0.85 for p-tau181.

Strength of evidence

Head-to-head analytical and clinical-validity study. Key constraints: assay versions, matrix and experimental conditions matter.

Clinical and field impactInterpretation, implementation, and access

Clinical significance

Require precision, specimen-handling, turnaround and regulatory fit alongside diagnostic performance when choosing a platform.

Field medical relevance

Interpret alongside these constraints: Lab study does not establish prospective utility or interchangeability.

Quanterix or platform relevance

Require precision, specimen-handling, turnaround and regulatory fit alongside diagnostic performance when choosing a platform.
